title: Management list tables stay readable in a short window

root_cause.page_body_overflow_hidden: src/platform/components/PageHeader.tsx line 79 gave PageBody in fill mode overflow-hidden, preventing vertical page scrolling when top controls, banners, the table, and the pager exceeded a short viewport height (1274x627).
root_cause.data_table_min_h_0: src/platform/components/DataTable.tsx line 41 gave Card in fillViewport mode min-h-0, so flexbox compressed the table viewport to the remaining height (measured at 1274x627: strategies scrollerClientHeight 84px of 239px; personas 341px; artifacts 293px).
root_cause.table_sticky_header_intercepted: src/components/ui/table.tsx wraps <table> in <div class='relative w-full overflow-auto'>, which intercepted position:sticky on <TableHeader className='sticky top-0 z-10 bg-card'> inside DataTable so the header scrolled off-screen instead of sticking to PinnedHorizontalScroll's scroll viewport.
root_cause.wheel_overscroll_contained: src/platform/components/PinnedHorizontalScroll.tsx line 83 set overscroll-contain on [data-management-table-scrollbar='native'], blocking mouse wheel events at the table's scroll boundary from chaining to scroll PageBody.

changes.src/platform/components/PageHeader.tsx: In PageBody fill mode, replaced overflow-hidden with overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden while preserving the FE-AI-BUTTON-PAGER-CLEARANCE-20261107 bottom clearance padding pb-[calc(1rem+var(--page-body-bottom-clearance,0px))] sm:pb-[calc(1.5rem+var(--page-body-bottom-clearance,0px))].
changes.src/platform/components/DataTable.tsx: In fillViewport mode, replaced min-h-0 with min-h-[384px] on Card and min-h-[320px] on the scroll viewport so both Card (384px) and inner scroll viewport clientHeight (367px with 2px border and 15px horizontal scrollbar) are never shorter than 320px and fit >=4 full 77px deployment rows below the 48px sticky header (4*77+48+15+2=373px <= 384px) without altering 1920x1000 layout (where smallest Card height is 474px). Added [&>div]:overflow-visible to PinnedHorizontalScroll contentClassName so sticky TableHeader sticks to the scroll viewport (theadStickyDelta=0), and single-line truncation on secondary artifact ID elements (artifact-id, artifact-strategy-id, artifact-persona-id).
changes.src/platform/components/PinnedHorizontal: Removed overscroll-contain from the native scroll viewport so mouse wheel events over a table at its scroll end continue to scroll PageBody.
Updated fill-mode test assertion from overflow-hidden to overflow-y-auto and overflow-x-hidden while verifying bottom clearance padding.
changes.src/platform/components/DataTable.test.t: Added unit test verifying fillViewport min-h-[384px] on Card, min-h-[320px] and absence of overscroll-contain on the scroll viewport, and document-mode min-h-0 preservation.
changes.src/management/pages/ObjectListPage.test: Updated fill-mode class assertions on pageBody and dataTable and added a 13-page suite verifying all 13 ObjectListPage consumers keep their scrollable fill PageBody, >=320px table area, filters, pager, empty, and unavailable states.
changes.e2e/management-list-short-window.spec.ts: Added Playwright spec with real scrollbars (ignoreDefaultArgs: ['--hide-scrollbars']) across 1274x627, 1280x720, and 1920x1000 for strategies, personas, artifacts, and deployments using real captured BFF row shapes, plus mouse wheel scroll-chaining verification.

acceptance_coverage.1: In fill mode PageBody scrolls vertically when content does not fit (pageBodyScrollHeight 769 > 486 on strategies@1274x627, 560 > 486 on artifacts@1274x627, 512 > 486 on personas/deployments@1274x627) and the table area is never shorter than 320px (cardHeight >= 384px, scrollerHeight >= 382px, scrollerClientHeight >= 367px across all routes and viewports). At 1920x1000 the measured layout is identical to before (pageBodyClientHeight=859, pageBodyScrollHeight=859, strategies cardHeight=474/scrollerClientHeight=457, personas cardHeight=731/scrollerClientHeight=729, artifacts cardHeight=683/scrollerClientHeight=681, deployments cardHeight=731/scrollerClientHeight=729, pagerBottom=896, aiButtonTop=936).
acceptance_coverage.2: e2e/management-list-short-window.spec.ts runs with hide-scrollbars off at 1274x627, 1280x720, and 1920x1000 for strategies, personas, artifacts, and deployments with a fixture BFF serving real row shapes: after at most one page scroll, visible full rows at 1274x627 are strategies=6, personas=6, artifacts=4, deployments=4 (all >=4); at 1280x720 are strategies=6, personas=7, artifacts=4, deployments=5; at 1920x1000 are strategies=7, personas=8, artifacts=11, deployments=8. Sticky header stays fixed (theadStickyDelta=0 on all 12 route-viewport combinations). Pager and assistant button never overlap (overlaps=false; strategies pagerBottom/aiButtonTop: 523<=563 at 1274x627, 616<=656 at 1280x720, 896<=936 at 1920x1000).
acceptance_coverage.3: Removing overscroll-contain in PinnedHorizontalScroll allows mouse wheel events over a table at its vertical end to scroll PageBody (verified in e2e/management-list-short-window.spec.ts: wheel down at table bottom advances pageBody.scrollTop from 0 to >0; wheel up at table top returns pageBody.scrollTop to 0). FE-AI-BUTTON-PAGER-CLEARANCE-20261107 clearance (--page-body-bottom-clearance: 5rem) is preserved.
acceptance_coverage.4: All 13 pages using ObjectListPage (StrategiesList, PersonasList, CapitalPoolsList, RankingFormulasList, RebalancesList, DeploymentsList, EvolutionList, ResearchList, ArtifactsList, ToolsList, McpServersList, SkillsList, ChannelsList) keep their filters, pager, empty, and unavailable states (verified in ObjectListPage.test.tsx, 30/30 tests passing). No existing test was weakened or deleted.

changed_assertions_justification.reason: PageHeader.tsx line 79 overflow-hidden was the explicit root cause identified in the task brief preventing PageBody in fill mode from scrolling vertically when content exceeds a short window.
PageHeader.tsx line 79 overflow-hidden and DataTable.tsx line 41 min-h-0 were the two explicit root causes identified in the task brief that crushed table height in short viewports.

residual_findings.finding: EvidenceExplorerList and PersonaFleet copy the custom h-full min-h-0 overflow-hidden section layout outside ObjectListPage (evidence table viewport is 23px at 1274x627).
StrategiesList (11 columns) and ArtifactsList (10 columns) exceed 1274px width and require horizontal scrolling until column consolidation lands.
